title: Checkboxes doesn't appear in global menu for gtk applications
line: GTK apps like LibreOffice now show the right check marks in the Global Menu the first time a menu is opened.
explanation: GTK apps like LibreOffice only fill in the state of a submenu's items when the menu's GMenu submenu-action is set to true, which is what GTK does when it opens a menu, but gmenudbusmenuproxy never did it; on top of that the Global Menu applet's full view pops up its own copy of the menu, so the app was never even told a menu opened. Items whose action only got a state later were also ignored, because the dbusmenu importer never applied a toggle-type change, and the proxy only refreshed the first item using a changed action. Now the applet forwards opening and closing to the importer, the proxy sets and clears the submenu-action on those events, the importer makes items checkable (or radio) when their toggle-type arrives later, and every item sharing an action is refreshed.

commits.message:
appmenu: show the check marks of GTK apps when their menus open

GTK apps like LibreOffice only update check marks while a submenu's
submenu-action is set, which the proxy never did, and items becoming
checkable later were ignored. Now opening a menu sets it, and both work.

BUG: 399623

media.caption: Master, LibreOffice Writer (GTK3), View opened from the Global Menu: Status Bar is unchecked although the status bar is visible, Sidebar and Navigator have no checkbox.
With the fix, same steps: Status Bar and Sidebar are checked, Navigator shows an empty checkbox.
